68e0fa84e2ede61c.description: Job description Company Description Mövenpick Hotel & Residences Riyadh Job Description Our Vision, we make moments Mövenpick Hotels & Residences (MH&R) is in the “moments” business. We’re intimately involved in important times in our guests lives. And you never know when a moment can be made. A simple smile in the lobby can create the positivity that turns a business trip into a new business celebration. An insider tip on the best way to spend a day can make an entire holiday. A romantic dinner for two can lead to a longer-term partnership. It doesn’t take much to create a moment — just be genuine, human, and warm. Take small steps to turn the ordinary into something extraordinary We understand that this vision cannot be achieved without great people who create and support work environments designed to produce exceptional results. The Role 1. To oversee and lead the Banquet department of the Hotel. 2. Banquet Manager is responsible for the smooth operation of his/her specific Event as governed by contract and deemed by operational requirements. 3. He or she must be fully responsible for the daily operation and maintenance of banquet FF&E and OSE, as well as for organizing storage areas and ensuring cleanliness. 4. He/she is responsible in linking all facets of cuisine and entertainment and then delivering these to guests. 5. He/she must be able to control and coordinate a labour pool of many and varied backgrounds. 6. He/she will have a majority of casual labour and hence it is essential to have quality staff management skills. 7. Should be creative and confident and be prepared to step outside of the confines of comfort. 8. He/she should take the time to get to know the guests and be committed to service excellence. 9. Team play is imperative and having the time to invest in self-development is mandatory. 10. Being entrepreneurial, thinking beyond the boundaries and leading by example are expected and not requested. Key Deliverables and Responsibilities Planning & Organizing: 1. Ensure that all Mövenpick Hotels & Residences standards are adhered. 2. He/she must check the daily casual staff's grooming standards and verify their Ajeer permits and iqamas on a daily basis without fail (if the Ajeer permits and iqamas are not available, the concerned casual staff must be sent back to the company immediately without fail). 3. Be innovative at all the time. 4. Keep ahead of industry trends (you should set the trends rather than follow) 5. Develop ideas on increasing guest satisfaction. 6. The role is to uphold the Movenpick service standard and manage daily in-house and ODC events. Operations: 1. Leads the daily and weekly meeting. 2. Train and develop the Banquet team in the departmental operating standards. 3. Maintains a presence during events including outside catering events. 4. Maintain a consistent focus on improving the overall flow of Banquet operations. 5. To lead and support employees in the achievement of financial, operational and service delivery targets via effective organizational policy and procedural development and appropriate employee training activities. 6. Foster a winning, solution-oriented work environment, motivating and engaging employees to continuously deliver the best possible service and to provide feedback and suggestions. 7. Source and audition entertainment and decorative options suitable for Banquets and Events. 8. Maintain awareness of industry trends and share with the team. 9. Review, analyse market and competition changes and implement proactive action plans to meet these changes in cooperation with Banquet manager and approved by Director of F&B. 10. Ensure organizers are communicated with and assisted in an efficient, warm and professional manner by all team members. 11. Actively review organizer and guest comments and feedback, communicate this with the team members and implement procedures to enhance guest satisfaction 12. To ensure a consistently high standard of grooming is followed and the team. 13. To have a complete understanding of and to adhere to Mövenpick Hotels & Residences policy relating to Fire, Hygiene, Health and Safety. 14. To drive the performance of the Banquet team members, including completion of performance appraisals, coaching counselling and performance management in conjunction with Human Resources. 15. Have full knowledge of all products and services provided by the property and in the local area. 16. Assume the responsibility of daily banquet operations. 17. Maintain appropriate staffing levels on the banquet floor. 18. Following up on opening and closing checklists on daily basis. 19. Ensure all appropriate equipment is on hand for each service period. 20. Ensure all the storages are well maintain and organize. 21. Ensures that the correct ordering and billing procedures are in place and that all cash handling is carried out correctly. This includes overseeing and checking the cashier and floats at the conclusion of the event and all banking done (specially banquet event order must be carefully monitored prier closing the bills) 22. All the banquet event orders (BEO) must be clearly studied and communicate with entire banquet team and concern departments. 23. Conducts daily briefings and training for all staff prior to commencement of shift, providing such information as service requirements, sequence and preparation for the day 24. Must be capable of handling security incidents, guest complaints or queries with confidence and in a professional manner. 25. Directly work with F&B director and all banquet employees to create a flow of new and ‘improved’ ideas. 26. Ensure awareness and deliver the optimum levels of service and guest satisfaction 27. Attaining and maintaining the sanitation (HACCP or similar) certificates as required by the regional governing body. 28. Ensure all hotel property and facilities are maintained an in an optimal working order. 29. Take full ownership and responsibility for any issues that may occur in the department. 30. Ensure rooms/events is set prior to the commencement of service. 31. Master all POS systems 32. To carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned. Administration: 1. Establish and maintain effective employee relationships. 2. Implement training plans to further develop self and subordinate outlet employees. 3. Lead by example through a passionate, hands on approach. 4. Maintaining all outlet records. 5. Maintain and submit the month-end banquet operations report, including casual and permanent attendance, AV rental details. 6. Evaluate an employee’s performance in staff appraisals, with a focus on adherence to procedures and departmental standards. Core Behaviors Core behaviors are our actions: what we say, what we do, and how we interact with one another. Our behaviors come from what we believe in, what we value. At Mövenpick Hotels & Residences, we call these value-based behaviors. The following statements provide indicators of the types of behaviors we expect employees in our company to display. Trust: Operates with fairness and integrity, fostering an environment of transparency and sincerity through open and honest communication and by honoring commitments. Relationships: We build and maintain strong connections with colleagues and guests, valuing diversity in people and perspectives whilst overcoming potential obstacles to increase cooperation and collaboration. Drive: We are action-oriented, setting direction for self and others, clarifying goals and objectives and overcoming barriers and challenges to produce results. Entrepreneurship: We fully understand the business and market context, identifying and seizing opportunities for continuous improvement and supporting change. 68671816a3c24860.description: Lead Qiddiya’s fixed-site general security operating model, with clear accountability for static guarding, security posts, access control, staffing for dynamic & fixed-location pedestrian and baggage screening, asset protection, and contracted guard-force performance. The role owns fixed-location security delivery and does not own patrol tasking, rapid response, alarm response or security escorts, which are owned by the Senior Manager, Mobile Security & Patrols. Key Responsibilities • Direct and assure fixed-site security operations across assigned assets, critical infrastructure and public-realm locations, including static guarding, security-post coverage, access control, pedestrian and baggage screening, visitor/personnel access control, protection of critical assets and infrastructure, and public-facing security services. • Convert approved security requirements, MOSP controls, risk assessments and asset security plans into site-specific standard operating procedures, post orders, deployment plans, staffing requirements, supervisory arrangements, daily tasking and auditable operational records. • Lead General Security employees and contracted personnel, establishing clear reporting lines, shift-level supervision and performance expectations, and holding responsible managers and service providers accountable for staffing compliance, licensing, competence, conduct, welfare, attendance and service quality. • Develop, implement and maintain site-specific procedures for static posts, foot patrols, fixed access points, visitor and contractor processing (access management implementation), credential verification, pedestrian and baggage screening, searches, prohibited-item handling and restricted-area access under City Security responsibility. • Establish, approve, issue and periodically review post orders, access-control procedures, local emergency actions, incident logs, handover records and other fixed-site operational documentation, ensuring current versions are relevant to the operation and audit ready. • Monitor contracted guarding providers against approved staffing levels, licenses, rosters, shift patterns, supervisory coverage, uniform and equipment standards, welfare requirements and agreed KPIs; document deficiencies, assign corrective actions and escalate repeated or material non-compliance. • Review and control proposed changes to security posts, shift arrangements, staffing levels, operating hours and contracted service scope, ensuring that operational, risk, welfare, commercial and approval impacts are assessed and formally authorized before implementation. • Plan and conduct documented field inspections of security posts, access-control points, screening operations and critical-infrastructure protection measures; record non-conformances, assign owners and deadlines, escalate overdue or high-risk findings and verify evidence of corrective-action closure. • Lead fixed-site security readiness for new city asset openings and operational transitions, confirming approved post locations, staffing and supervision, access and screening arrangements, welfare facilities, communications, equipment, standard operating procedures, emergency response plans, training, rehearsals and mobilization acceptance before go-live. • Direct the fixed-site operational response and follow-up for access breaches, screening failures, losses and asset-protection incidents, ensuring immediate controls, preservation of evidence, timely reporting and escalation, investigation support, corrective-action tracking and coordinated closure with DSOC and relevant stakeholders. • Maintain documented tasking, escalation and handover arrangements with Mobile Security & Patrols for reinforcement, patrol support, alarm response, security escorts and incident response, while retaining General Security accountability for fixed-site command, access control and site-level continuity. • Provide security operational input during stage-gate briefings, identifying fixed-site security requirements, dependencies, risks and readiness actions to support informed decisions and ensure asset operational readiness before handover / opening. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent recognised qualification in security, risk, operations, business or a related discipline. Professional Certifications - CPP, CSMP, PSP or equivalent desirable. Incident command, contract management or health and safety qualifications are desirable. 10+ years in security operations, including substantial management responsibility. Proven leadership of static guarding, access control, fixed-post operations and asset protection across multiple locations. Experience managing contracted guard forces, staffing compliance, KPIs, non-conformance and service recovery. Experience supporting asset openings, public-facing operations and elevated security requirements in a complex environment. Saudi Arabia, GCC, major destination, critical infrastructure or giga-project experience is advantageous.

68b62f7d8612b19b.description: About IBIS and the Tamayyaz Program IBIS is offering a full-time opportunity in Jeddah and Makkah, Saudi Arabia, through its Tamayyaz Nationalization Development Program. The Tamayyaz program is designed to equip Saudi talents with essential skills and knowledge for various hospitality professions through a combination of classroom instruction and on-the-job training within a structured timeframe. Role Overview: Guest Service Agent The Tamayyaz Guest Service Agent is responsible for ensuring a smooth and courteous experience for guests from arrival to departure. This role involves managing daily front office operations, handling guest inquiries and requests, and maintaining efficient communication across departments to support overall hotel operations. Key Responsibilities Prepare for daily arrivals, including room allocation and checking for special guest requests. Register and process guest check-ins, updating information in the system. Perform cashiering duties, foreign exchange transactions, night audit tasks, and settlement upon guest departure. Handle walk-in counter reservations and process call-in reservations when the room reservations section is closed. Provide courteous service, responding promptly to all guest requests and inquiries. Resolve guest complaints and requests, liaising with relevant departments for immediate follow-up and reporting issues to supervisors. Manage the issuance of guest room key cards and ensure effective control for guest security. Check and convey messages to guests. Assist at the Information counter, Foreign Exchange, Night Audit, and Business Centre as assigned. Review the log book, verify outstanding items, and follow up on pending tasks, identifying any special assignments for the day. Monitor hotel situation, occupancy, functions, groups, and VIPs. File daily reception reports and documents systematically. Print panic reports at least twice per shift. Attend briefings, take notes, and ensure appropriate follow-up actions. Maintain focus on guests, eye contact, and acknowledge all guests at the desk. Communicate all necessary information to the next shift for continuous operational efficiency. Coordinate and share information with Front Office, Housekeeping, F&B, and the General Manager, particularly regarding VIPs. Maintain familiarity with company documentation and operational standards relevant to the role. Ensure perfect grooming at all times. Drive upselling initiatives. Carry out any other reasonable tasks as requested. Qualifications and Requirements This program is exclusively for Saudi Nationals. Open to candidates with 0-1 year of work experience, including fresh graduates and those with up to 6 months of relevant experience. Basic English language skills are required. Demonstrated strong passion for the hospitality field. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to work effectively as a team player and proactively assist co-workers. Flexibility to work a roster that adapts to departmental needs. Ability to focus on guest needs, maintaining a calm and courteous demeanor at all times. Diversity and Inclusion IBIS is committed to diversity and inclusion, aiming to attract, recruit, and promote diverse talent within its workforce.

684551e8d8458371.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة، حيث يركز على تصميم المباني والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع المعمارية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة، الملحقات، أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار الموقع المناسب للمشاريع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي، الرسومات، والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني وتقديم حلول معمارية مبتكرة. معرفة جيدة بمواد البناء والمواصفات الفنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق شركة إعمار الخليج للاستشارات الهندسية في الهفوف، المنطقة الشرقية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب التواجد في الموقع للإشراف على المشاريع. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل المنطقة: المنطقة الشرقية، الهفوف الراتب: غير معلن التقديم ندعو المهندسين المعماريين المؤهلين والمهتمين بهذه الفرصة للتقديم.

688c5862a45d35bc.description: About the Role The Red Sea Landscape Nursery is seeking a Director - Production to lead plant production at Botanica Red Sea. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves managing the growth and supply of plant material from the 180-hectare nursery, which has an annual production capacity of 8 million plants. The Director will oversee propagation, greenhouses, shade houses, flower and indoor plant production, the seed bank, and the native species program, while also leading R&D and biosecurity efforts. Role Context and Objectives This position is accountable for plant quality, availability, biosecurity, safety, and production costs. The Director ensures supply to the Commercial department at the assumed cost for both internal Red Sea Global (RSG) clients and external developments. The role requires joint planning with Nursery Operations for water, soil, logistics, and equipment, with key risks including plant losses from pests, disease, heat, biosecurity incursions, and changes in demand forecasts. Key Responsibilities Translate demand plans into production, import, and growing plans, achieving production volumes, plant readiness dates, germination, and survival targets. Manage live plant inventory and review plant Bills of Quantities (BOQs) for projects, confirming availability and lead times. Lead plant propagation, greenhouse and shade house operations, flower and food production, indoor plants, and the seed bank. Grow the native plant program and apply crop management practices to maximize quality and minimize losses. Own the Biosecurity Protocol, including inspection of incoming material, phytosanitary documentation, quarantine, and traceability. Lead the integrated pest and disease management (IPM) program and the R&D roadmap, ensuring compliance with MEWA requirements. Manage the direct cost budget for nursery production and R&D, controlling labor, materials, water, fuel, equipment, and wastage. Plan manpower, equipment, and materials, reporting utilization and productivity, and identifying cost and delivery risks. Lead managers, supervisors, horticulturists, and operatives, driving competency and training standards. Ensure zero-harm field operations, including permits, method statements, toolbox talks, PPE, and incident reporting. Follow and enforce all relevant Botanica and RSG Group policies, processes, and standard operating procedures. Apply and champion the safety, quality, and environmental management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) and the compliance management system (ISO 37301). Identify and lead opportunities for continuous improvement in department systems, processes, and practices. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience in plant production and nursery management. About Botanica Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. The company focuses on integrating new species with local flora and operates with a planet-first approach to sustainability. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a goal of 30 million by 2030, contributing to the natural landscapes of The Red Sea & Amaala. Application Process Candidates interested in this Director - Production position are encouraged to apply.

6897ec217112206e.description: About Medtronic Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology, committed to alleviating pain, restoring health, and extending life. Coordinate transportation and warehouse operations with third-party logistics (3PL) providers. Monitor inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts, reconciliations, and inventory control activities. Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, shipment issues, and operational exceptions. Track logistics KPIs and prepare operational reports to identify improvement opportunities. Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, and regulatory requirements for medical devices. Support stock transfers, product launches, and supply chain improvement initiatives. Collaborate with Customer Service, Planning, Procurement, Finance, Quality, and Commercial teams to ensure operational excellence. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in logistics or supply chain operations. The role requires a strong understanding of logistics processes and inventory management. Compensation and Benefits Medtronic offers a competitive salary and a flexible benefits package. The company is committed to its employees, recognizing their contributions and allowing them to share in the success they help create. A wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans are designed to support employees at every career and life stage. Decima International operates on a model that emphasizes client partnerships, fostering an environment for talented professionals, and regulating growth to maintain service excellence. The manager will coordinate with contractors, consultants, vendors, and the Owner through final testing, turnover, and acceptance processes. 68f3cce7299ade49.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية، وتحديد المتطلبات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة، ومتابعة سير العمل، بالإضافة إلى قياس الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطط الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قوائم بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المتنوعة، بالإضافة إلى تحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز المهام. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنجزة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للفرق العاملة، ومتابعة حضورهم، ورفع تقارير دورية حول الأعمال المنجزة. قياس الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها، وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية وفهمها. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأدوات ومعدات الصيانة المختلفة. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع فرق العمل والمهندسين. الدقة في حساب الكميات وإعداد التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المباني، وتتطلب متابعة ميدانية للأعمال. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

6802351519c2da3b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جود العلياء عن أمين مخزن للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية استلام المواد والسلع الواردة إلى المستودع، وتنظيمها وتخزينها، وصرفها للجهات المعنية، بالإضافة إلى المشاركة في عمليات جرد المخزون. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استلام المواد المراد إدخالها للمستودعات والتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات المذكورة في طلبات الشراء أو التوريد أو العينات. تنظيم وترتيب البضائع والمعدات والمواد الأخرى الموردة إلى المستودع ووضعها في أماكنها الصحيحة وتثبيت البيانات الخاصة بها. تحضير المواد وتجهيزها وصرفها للجهات المعنية بموجب سندات صرف وفقاً لآلية الصرف المعتمدة. تحديد الاحتياجات من السلع والمواد عند وصول المخزون إلى حد الطلب. حفظ معاملات الإدخالات والإخراجات المتعلقة بالمستودع. المشاركة في جرد المخزون ومطابقة نتائج الجرد الفعلي لأرصدة الدفاتر والسجلات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال أمين مخزن أو ما يعادله. القدرة على استلام المواد والتحقق من مطابقتها للمواصفات. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لترتيب وتخزين البضائع بكفاءة. المهارات المطلوبة الدقة والانتباه للتفاصيل في عمليات الجرد والتخزين. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. مهارات التواصل الفعال. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة جود العلياء. يلتزم أمين المخزن بالعمل وفقاً للإجراءات والسياسات المعتمدة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية التوظيف. نشجع المتقدمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على تقديم طلباتهم.

68159198690c3db3.description: About SYSTRA SYSTRA is a global engineering and consultancy group specializing in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA focuses on designing safe and sustainable transport solutions to connect communities, foster social inclusion, and facilitate access to employment, education, and leisure worldwide. For 65 years, SYSTRA has partnered with cities and regions to develop, improve, and modernize infrastructure and transport systems across the project lifecycle, from design to testing, deployment, and maintenance. Operating in over 80 countries, SYSTRA generates 74% of its turnover internationally and supports clients in their digital, ecological, and energy transitions. Project Delivery Manager (Rail) Bid Opportunity This role is for a Project Delivery Manager (Rail) based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage; any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval. The Project Delivery Manager will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of conventional railway and freight rail programs, with a strong focus on construction execution, package coordination, interface management, and delivery performance. Role Overview The Project Delivery Manager will lead the successful delivery of conventional railway and freight rail programs. This role requires a highly capable leader with deep expertise in managing large-scale conventional railway, freight rail, and associated infrastructure works. Key responsibilities include coordinating multidisciplinary teams, resolving complex technical and delivery interfaces, and ensuring execution aligns with project requirements for schedule, budget, quality, safety, and operational performance. The position demands substantial experience in delivering integrated works across conventional rail corridors, freight alignments, yards, depots, terminals, and associated infrastructure, including coordination of civil, structural, track, systems, MEP, architectural, utilities, and operational interfaces, while ensuring compliance with project specifications, applicable standards, regulatory requirements, and the operational needs of conventional and freight railway systems. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage the overall construction delivery of the railway program across multiple project packages, work fronts, or contractor interfaces. Drive site execution strategies to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of all construction activities. Oversee and coordinate construction teams, subcontractors, package managers, and support functions to achieve program milestones. Ensure strong integration between engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, planning, contracts, and project controls functions. Monitor construction progress and productivity, implementing recovery plans where required to address delays or performance gaps. Manage site-related risks, constructability issues, sequencing constraints, logistics challenges, and interface coordination across the program. Lead delivery reviews, construction progress meetings, and reporting processes to ensure transparency and timely decision-making. Ensure construction activities are executed in compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, and HSE regulations. Support the development of construction methodologies, phasing plans, mobilization strategies, and execution plans during bid and post-award stages. Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and the client on all matters related to delivery and construction performance. Promote a strong site culture focused on safety, quality, productivity, accountability, and delivery excellence. Support testing, commissioning readiness, and handover planning in coordination with relevant teams, where required. Qualifications and Skills Over 10 years of experience in project delivery, with a strong focus on construction execution in complex railway environments. Proven ability to manage complex railway works in live and challenging environments, driving site performance and managing contractors and interfaces. Prior conventional railway and freight rail project experience is essential. Gulf experience is preferred. Strong understanding of construction sequencing, site logistics, temporary works, constructability, project controls, and commercial impacts on delivery. Demonstrated ability to manage complex construction interfaces and multidisciplinary teams in large project environments. Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills. Strong knowledge of HSE, quality, risk, compliance, and construction best practices in major infrastructure projects, including the requirements of conventional and freight railway systems. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. SYSTRA is an equal opportunities company, and this position is open to all applicants.

68b64b16c0ae4803.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة العلامة البارقة عن محاسب تكاليف للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط ودراسة وتحليل عناصر حسابات التكلفة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بمحاسبة التكاليف وحفظها. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط ودراسة الأساليب المستخدمة في حساب التكلفة، وتحديد عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة، وإجراء حسابات التكلفة. تحليل عناصر التكلفة المباشرة وغير المباشرة بشكل دوري، وتحديد معدل التكلفة المعيارية، وتحديد الانحرافات ومساهمة كل منها في زيادة أو تقليل التكلفة. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بالتكاليف وطرق التسعير، وتقديم التوصيات اللازمة للإدارة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات حساب التكاليف ومواكبة التطورات العلمية والتقنية في مجال المحاسبة وحساب التكلفة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بحساب التكاليف، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال محاسبة التكاليف. فهم عميق لمبادئ وأساليب حساب التكلفة. القدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية وتحديد الانحرافات. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية. القدرة على تطوير وتحسين إجراءات العمل المحاسبية. مهارات تحليلية قوية ودقة في التفاصيل. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية في شركة العلامة البارقة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في محاسبة التكاليف.

682b44b4ca3eb499.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أطياف للخدمات المساندة عن مشرف صيانة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على جميع جوانب عمليات الصيانة، بما في ذلك تخطيط العمل وتوزيع المهام وتطوير برامج الصيانة الوقائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد خطة وبرنامج العمل الشامل لعمليات الصيانة. متابعة إجراءات تحديد نوع وطبيعة الصيانة المطلوبة وتقدير كمية وتكلفة المواد اللازمة. توزيع المهام والواجبات على أعضاء فريق الصيانة بناءً على إمكاناتهم وقدراتهم. متابعة وتقييم أداء فريق الصيانة وتقييم إنجازاتهم بشكل دوري. تقييم الاحتياجات التدريبية لفرق الصيانة وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها بفعالية. تصنيف وترتيب وتوثيق وحفظ نتائج وتقارير العمل المتعلقة بالصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الصيانة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على إعداد خطط وبرامج العمل ومتابعة تنفيذها. مهارات جيدة في توزيع المهام وإدارة فريق العمل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وتخطيطية ممتازة. القدرة على تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. مهارات التواصل الفعال والعمل ضمن فريق. الدقة في تصنيف وتوثيق التقارير والنتائج. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ويقع في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة أطياف للخدمات المساندة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

684d9e4e9ee788d9.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Demi Chef de Partie to join their team in Medina, Al Madinah. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a similar culinary role. Demonstrated ability to follow recipes and maintain food quality standards. Understanding of food safety and hygiene practices. 68a0e356244c3025.description: نبحث عن استشاري مبيعات متحمس للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تحقيق أهداف النمو. ستقوم بتطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات المبيعات المبتكرة، وبناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة، وقدرة على الإقناع، وشغفاً بتحقيق النجاح، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. * تحديد فرص المبيعات الجديدة وتطوير خطط عمل فعالة. * تقديم عروض تقديمية مقنعة للمنتجات أو الخدمات. * متابعة العملاء المحتملين والحاليين لضمان رضاهم. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات الشهرية والربع سنوية. * العمل عن كثب مع فرق التسويق والإنتاج لضمان تجربة عملاء سلسة.

68ba0af940c6f164.description: The Warehouse Chemist is responsible for ensuring the safe, compliant, and efficient management of chemicals and dangerous goods within warehouse operations. Key Responsibilities Receive, inspect, identify, classify, and verify chemicals and dangerous goods to ensure compliance with purchase specifications and regulatory requirements. Minimum of four (4) years of experience in chemical warehouse operations, hazardous materials management, laboratory, or industrial chemical environments. Strong knowledge of chemical properties, hazard classification, compatibility, and hazardous material handling practices. Familiarity with applicable regulations, including GHS, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR), IMDG Code, ADR, and local regulatory requirements. Proficiency in interpreting and applying Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and implementing safe chemical storage and segregation practices. Experience conducting chemical risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Good understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management systems, hazardous waste management, and environmental compliance.
